rulings.statement: Tây Sơn owns an independent grammar and never inherits product truth from a StarCi profile.
appliesWhen: a frontend surface belongs to the Tây Sơn product family
doesNotApplyWhen: the surface belongs to StarCi Academy or another product family

rulings.statement: The Tây Sơn public website uses its approved green-and-ivory editorial identity with public navigation and no authenticated app chrome.
appliesWhen: a visitor opens a public Tây Sơn route
doesNotApplyWhen: an authenticated staff member opens an internal CRM operation

rulings.statement: Published community information is presented as one addressable editorial document with retrieval states and truthful continuation.
appliesWhen: published introduction, charter or board content is publicly addressed
doesNotApplyWhen: content is unpublished or ordinary marketing copy

rulings.statement: The Tây Sơn CRM is an authenticated operational application inside the same monorepo and brand grammar, not a public editorial page or member portal.
appliesWhen: Admin, Manager or Staff operates approved CMS or CRM capabilities
doesNotApplyWhen: a public visitor browses the website
a member portal, sales pipeline, payment or ticket capability is proposed without business authority

rulings.statement: An internal Tây Sơn collection or workflow queue exposes request, empty, failure and permission outcomes while rendering only role-allowed actions.
appliesWhen: CRM content, members, submissions, users, audit or backup records are collected
doesNotApplyWhen: one bounded record is edited in a form
the collection is public and ungated

rulings.statement: An internal Tây Sơn form owns disabled, submitting, success, error and role-permission outcomes around one primary operation.
appliesWhen: CRM content, account or site configuration is edited
doesNotApplyWhen: records are only browsed as a collection
the form is a public marketing call to action
